decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm's established offer, is still mentioned on the website in 2024, and with the firm's slack in a growing industry, its results can be absorbed while uncertainty remains, so there is no trigger to drop it.

As a secure messaging service aligned with regulatory digital workflows and presented on its own page after the KIM 1.5 update, it appears to meet the firm's aspirations and is supported by existing slack, so it is likely to be kept.
